answer: An honest agent brings the raven, accepts the pulse as fair, and leaves the bridge any stranger can verify. Kaolin lanternmaker licence with lanternmakers attestation is what separates a real lanternmaker from a rented name — a licence lanternmakers renew after flame audits. The trade takes 2 seasons to learn and 1200 flame inspections to prove; copies multiply the bill, not the payout. That is the price of one honest name.
